accountLiveness.title: Account liveness
accountLiveness.singleHint: Send one short real message to one automatically selected text model. Does not enable the account or clear a cooldown.
accountLiveness.notice: Each tested account sends one short real message and consumes one normal text request. Only one automatically selected model is checked, not every model. Batch checks run serially and show why disabled or cooling accounts are skipped.
accountLiveness.sessionOnly: Results stay in this app session only. A successful check does not enable an account, change credential status or clear a cooldown; newly detected provider restrictions still pause the account automatically.
accountLiveness.controlError: Could not start, read or stop the check. Review the current progress; requests are never automatically repeated.
accountLiveness.cancelNotice: The current request may already have been submitted; stopping remaining checks does not retract it.

reasons.disabled: Manually disabled account; skipped by the batch.
reasons.provider_disabled: Disabled provider; skipped by the batch.
reasons.cooldown: Account is cooling down or paused. No request was sent.
reasons.daily_limit: The account has reached its local daily limit.
reasons.provider_missing: The provider configuration no longer exists.
reasons.no_text_model: No verified text model is available for this check.
reasons.auth_required: Sign in again or update credentials.
reasons.action_required: Complete sign-in or manual verification in the account browser.
reasons.rate_limited: This account or model has temporarily reached its request limit.
reasons.quota_unavailable: The model quota cannot currently be verified safely.
reasons.browser_unavailable: The account browser is not ready. Open its login window and check that the website is available and signed in, then test again. This does not mean the account is invalid.
reasons.model_unavailable: The selected model is unavailable or not permitted for this account. Check the available models on the website; this does not mean the account is permanently unusable.
reasons.account_banned: The provider has restricted this account; manual review is required.
reasons.incomplete_response: No complete, valid reply was received.
reasons.request_failed: Request failed and was not automatically retried.
reasons.timeout: The check timed out and was not automatically retried.
reasons.cancelled: Remaining checks stopped; an already submitted request may still be charged.
reasons.account_changed: The account or provider changed before submission; this check was skipped.
reasons.internal_error: This check could not be completed. Please review it later.
